fact: On 5 May 2021 the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications issued an international tender for a main data centre at Bangui Sica and a backup data centre (rehabilitated rooms) at the Ministry's own site, under the CAB project.
title: Avis d'appel d'offres: fourniture, formation, installation d'equipements informatiques, reseaux, etc. et construction et operationnalisation d'un Datacenter principal et de secours
publisher: Ministere des Postes et Telecommunications, Unite de coordination du projet CAB
